interface FieldAfterMethod {
  foo(): number;
}
class FieldAfterMethod {
  foo = 'wrong';
}
interface MethodAfterField {
  foo: string;
}
class MethodAfterField {
  foo() {return 3;}
}
interface CallableField {
  foo: () => number;
}
class CallableField {
  foo() {return 3;}
}
interface GetterAfterMethod {
  foo(): number;
}
class GetterAfterMethod {
  get foo() {return () => 3;}
}
interface RepeatedGetter {
  get foo(): number;
}
class RepeatedGetter {
  get foo() {return 3;}
}
interface ParameterAfterMethod {
  foo(): number;
}
class ParameterAfterMethod {
  constructor(public foo: string) {}
}
interface ChangedGetter {
  get foo(): number;
}
class ChangedGetter {
  foo = 'wrong';
}
interface ReadonlyAfterGetter {
  get value(): number;
}
class ReadonlyAfterGetter {
  readonly value = 3;
}
